SREL
0 - Non-release operation
1 - Release operation
This indicator exists in the channel status table for a
single unit channel and in the unit status table for a
multi-unit channel. The release indicator is set by the
actuator whenever a release pseudo-operation is
requested. The indicator is tested by the receptor.
SUNRES
0 - Not reserved
1 - Reserved
This indicator exists in the channel status table of a
single unit channel and in the unit status table of a
multi-unit channel. It is a second level indicator for
special situations in I-O assignment reservation of
units. It has priority over SOVRES. It is set and
tested by the i-O assignment program.
SOVRES
0 - Not reserved
1 - Reserved
This indicator exists in the channel status table of a
single unit channel and in the unit status table of a
multi-unit channel. It is used by I-O assignment to
ascertain those units which have been preassigned in
the overlapped mode of operation and is set and tested
by I-O assignment.
